_doc: Hand-found control-flow facts from the two recompilation projects (READMEs,
git log, run_ghidra_*.sh). Each is a regression check for SuperSpider.
needs: what SuperSpider must do to find it without being told.
retaddr  - return-address tracking (LR/stack, pushed PC, LR+k)
table    - bounded indirect jump / jump table
memvar   - jump target carried through memory
reloc    - code copied elsewhere and run there
header   - format-defined entry points (module header etc.)
none     - expected to stay out of reach (dead code, or runtime-built)
